map.→ 打开音频采样率转换工具: -> Open the audio sample rate conversion tool
map.不会。升采样只是插入新采样点（插值），原本被截断的高频信息无法恢复；音质上限由原: No. Upsampling only inserts new sample points (interpolation); high-frequency information that was already cut off cannot be recovered. The quality ceiling is set by the sample rate and bit depth of the original recording.
map.为什么频响上限是采样率的一半？: Why is the upper limit of frequency response half the sample rate?
map.在不同采样率（如 44.1k、48k）间换算，输入声道数与位深计算音频文件大小，: Convert between different sample rates (such as 44.1k and 48k), enter channel count and bit depth to compute the audio file size, and derive the highest recordable frequency from the Nyquist theorem. Useful for choosing recording and mixing formats.
map.奈奎斯特采样定理：采样率必须大于信号最高频率的 2 倍才能无失真还原，故可表示的: Nyquist sampling theorem: the sample rate must be more than twice the highest frequency of the signal for a distortion-free reconstruction, so the highest representable frequency = sample rate / 2; anything above that produces aliasing.
map.对照 8/22.05/44.1/48/96 kHz 等常见采样率的频响上限，选择: Check the frequency response ceiling of common sample rates such as 8/22.05/44.1/48/96 kHz and pick suitable capture parameters.
map.按采样率、位深度、声道数与时长计算音频比特率与文件体积，评估存储与传输成本。: Computes the audio bit rate and file size from sample rate, bit depth, channel count and duration, to evaluate storage and transmission cost.
map.转换采样率前预估目标文件大小，判断是否需要重编码压缩。: Estimate the target file size before converting the sample rate to judge whether re-encoding and compression are needed.
map.：44.1 kHz / 16bit / 立体声(2ch) / 5 分钟：比特率: : 44.1 kHz / 16 bit / stereo (2ch) / 5 minutes: bit rate = 44100 x 16 x 2 = 1,411,200 bps ~= 1411 kbps; size = 1411200 x 300 / 8 / 1024 / 1024 ~= 50.5 MB; frequency response ceiling 22.05 kHz. The same settings at 48 kHz give about 55.0 MB.
map.：比特率(bps) = 采样率 × 位深度 × 声道数；文件大小(MB) = 比: : bit rate (bps) = sample rate x bit depth x channel count; file size (MB) = bit rate x duration (seconds) / 8 / 1024 / 1024; the frequency response ceiling is sample rate / 2 (the Nyquist frequency). Downsampling requires low-pass filtering first, since high frequencies are cut off at the new Nyquist frequency; upsampling does not recover lost high frequencies, it only interpolates.
